Florida International University

The Future is Built Here

At Florida International University, discovery happens every day. From student-led research to global collaborations tackling society’s biggest challenges, FIU empowers the next generation of innovators, problem-solvers and leaders.

Start your application

Turn your Curiosity into Discovery

With more than 200 degree programs across 12 colleges, FIU offers a path for every ambition, whether that's a research lab, a courtroom, a hospital, a stage or a startup.

At FIU, learning goes beyond the classroom. Work alongside leading researchers, gain hands-on field experience, help produce one of the world’s largest hospitality events, study abroad or contribute to discoveries shaping health, technology and the environment.

What are you passionate about?

  • Arts and Design
  • Business and Economics
  • Education
  • Hospitality Management
  • Humanities and Culture
  • Medicine and Health
  • Public Policy
  • Sciences and Engineering
  • Technology

Browse all degrees

Discover What's Waiting for You

From the moment you step on campus, FIU feels like home. You'll challenge yourself, find support from a community that believes in your potential and connect with students who will become lifelong friends. And beyond campus, all of Miami is yours: the beaches, the culture, the career opportunities. Four years here can shape a lifetime.

Explore Student Life

Campus by the Numbers

  • 17 NCAA Division I Sports
  • 300+ Clubs, academic associations and professional organizations
  • 350K+ Alumni network
View this profile on Instagram

Florida International University (@fiuinstagram) • Instagram photos and videos

Research at FIU

Where the World Looks for Answers

At FIU, innovation isn’t just a headline—it’s a habit. It’s the momentum that’s helping FIU soar into the top 30 by 2030. It’s how we transform ideas into impact.

With more than $1.2 billion in research expenditures over the last five years, FIU researchers are improving coastal resilience, advancing medical discoveries in cancer and Alzheimer’s, driving innovation in AI and cybersecurity and informing global policy.

See FIU Research

Featured News

Miami’s First Quantum Computer is Coming to FIU

FIU has signed an agreement with IonQ, the world’s leading full-stack quantum platform and foundry, to install the company’s new Superion 256 quantum computer on our South Florida campus.

This system places FIU researchers and students among a select group with direct access to advanced quantum-computing hardware further establishing FIU as a leader in quantum research, training and industry partnerships.

Explore FIU Quantum initiatives

Latest News

  • Medicine & Health Sciences

    Common ADHD classroom accommodations may not help students succeed, FIU study finds

    Research in JAMA Pediatrics finds behavioral interventions and stimulant medication improve classroom outcomes, while common accommodations show no significant benefits.

  • Campus & Community

    Students share their successes with Board of Governors

    During the education leaders’ meeting on campus this week, several standouts discussed how they are thriving at FIU.

  • Science & Technology

    FIU scientists uncover hidden extinction risks in the deep sea

    FIU researchers analyzed genetic information from 486 specimens to understand how populations of certain species have changed over time and how vulnerable they may be.

  • Medicine & Health Sciences

    Could light reveal preterm birth risk?

    Biomedical engineering students are working to commercialize a device designed to detect early signs of preterm labor risk...in five seconds.


View more news

    • Get to Know FIU

      From top-ranked academic programs to top-tier research designation, FIU is a South Florida anchor institution and a solutions center for the world’s toughest challenges.

      In this Section

    • Think Local, Go Global

      With more than 54,000 students across South Florida and around the globe, FIU opens a world of opportunities to explore and gain a deeper understanding of our international community.

    • Ready to Get Started?

      The start of your journey is just an application away. Whether in-person or online, explore what FIU ― Miami's only public research university ― has to offer and get started today.

    • There’s a Degree for You

      From the humanities to STEM, FIU offers more than 190 degrees, including top-ranked fully online programs, to ensure there's an FIU degree that matches your interests and lifestyle.

    • Answering the Challenge

      Our researchers take on the toughest problems of our time to create marketable solutions. Half a century, 300+ patents and more than $2 billion in awards later, we're just getting started.

      In this Section

      • Research Overview

      Related Links

      • Office of Research and Economic Development
      • FIU Discovery
      • Research News

    • Get Involved, Be A Panther

      There's so many ways to be more than just a student: join a club, go tailgating, visit one of our museums or take in a concert. You'll also have everything you need for a complete on-campus experience.

      In this Section

      • Student Life Overview
      • Student Involvement

      • Federal Relief

      Related Links

    • Unleash Your Inner Panther

      Catch an exciting game in more than 17 Division-I sports ― and rep your alma mater while you cheer on future All Stars and gold medalists.

      In this Section

      • Athletics Overview

    • Be Part of the FIU Family

      With a network of more than 350,000, FIU is the alma mater of leaders and influencers around the world. With the support of our FIU family, we're changing lives and making a difference.
